name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After years managing complex supply chains for a tech firm in Shenzhen, a chance encounter with a former F3 driver sparked an interest that quickly became a passion. He saw the parallels between his logistical expertise and the intricate demands of racing, realizing his skills could translate seamlessly. He initially volunteered at local karting events before landing a full-time position with Vee Masters.

Wei prides himself on his ability to anticipate problems before they arise. His meticulous planning and calm demeanor make him a valuable asset, especially during high-pressure situations. He believes in fostering strong relationships with suppliers and team members, ensuring a smooth flow of resources and communication. Wei's innovative approach to logistics, such as implementing a real-time tracking system for equipment, sets him apart.

Wei is not afraid to challenge the status quo, consistently seeking ways to streamline processes and improve efficiency. He is respected by his colleagues for his dedication, his willingness to go the extra mile, and his dry wit that often diffuses tense situations.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a slightly wiry build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Insists on organizing all tools and equipment in order of size.
Always carries a small notebook filled with logistical flowcharts.
Has a specific brand of green tea he drinks before every race.
